description: This file defines a React component for the quizzes index page in a Remix application. It includes loader functions for fetching quiz data, metadata for page title, and the main component rendering a list or message about quizzes.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines the page metadata, setting the title.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches the list of published quizzes from the API when the route is loaded.

methods.name: QuizzesIndexRoute
methods.description: React component that renders the quiz catalog, displaying quiz cards or a message if none are available.
